title: Truth and Grace
description: A study through our statement of faith — what we believe and why it matters. The Truth & Grace course will equip all believers, but especially leaders, to be able to understand, explain and hold to the cirtical doctrines of the Church, especially those of Family Church.

chapters.title: Scripture
chapters.description: Understanding the nature and authority of Scripture, the Holy Bible.

chapters.title: God
chapters.description: What we believe about the nature and identity of God.

chapters.title: Humanity
chapters.description: What we believe about creation, humanity, marriage, and the Fall.

chapters.title: The Son of God
chapters.description: Exploring the Incarnation — who Jesus is, how He came, and what it means for us.
